description:
We're excited to introduce our complete 3D-printed footwear collection, featuring innovative designs built for different lifestyles — from everyday comfort and travel to outdoor adventures and fashion-forward looks.

To help you create content that drives conversions, we've organized our products into three categories:

🌟 New Arrivals (Fresh Drops to Excite Your Audience)

These are our latest innovations—perfect for hooking followers looking for something entirely new.

  • AirFlow (Our First-Ever Flip-Flop)

  • The Vibe: Ultra-light, breezy steps with premium support.

  • Key Features: This is our debut flip-flop! Weighing just 96g, it pairs a highly breathable hollow structure with our signature CloudFoam™ arch support.

  • How to Sell It: Pitch this as the ultimate summer essential for those who love the freedom of a classic flip-flop but desperately need better arch support.

  • Videos/Posts by our creators: https://www.instagram.com/p/Da72WAiDPvn/

  • AirWave (The Shark-Fin Slide)

  • The Vibe: Sleek design, unbeatable stability, and a massive lift.

  • Key Features: A standout slide featuring unique "shark-fin" widened sidewalls for supreme traction. It offers a 5cm height boost, dynamic 3D arch support, and an extra-wide entry for hands-free slip-on access.

  • How to Sell It: Target audiences who stand all day or want a bold, chunky slide silhouette that provides heavy-duty stability and arch relief.

  • Videos/Posts by our creators: https://www.instagram.com/p/DbQ7qUgitzM/    https://www.instagram.com/p/DbRPm2Nh_kM/   https://www.instagram.com/p/DbIM5aXOnWf/

🔥 Proven Best Sellers (High Conversions & Everyday Appeal)

Our most popular everyday essentials. If you are new to the program, start here!

  • Airpuff One (The Ultra-Light Slide)

  • The Vibe: Effortless, slip-on comfort that feels like walking on air.

  • Key Features: Our flagship ultra-light slide. Weighing an astonishingly light 85g, it features an ultra-thin, flexible upper and responsive 3D-printed cushioning.

  • How to Sell It: Target the work-from-home audience or those looking for the perfect "lazy day" house slide or quick errand shoe.

  • Videos/Posts by our creators: https://www.instagram.com/p/DbGY1eUoPZg/   https://www.instagram.com/p/DV8mhGGDtLW/   https://www.instagram.com/p/DSElREXDYUw/ 

  • Aero (The Ultra-Light Foldable Shoe)

  • The Vibe: A flexible, second-skin fit for life on the go.

  • Key Features: A fully enclosed, ultra-light (89g) shoe that boasts a 360° flexible design, meaning it bends and packs easily without losing its shape.

  • How to Sell It: Pitch this to travelers, digital nomads, and commuters. Show your audience how this full shoe can be folded flat and packed into any carry-on luggage.

  • Videos/Posts by our creators: https://www.instagram.com/p/DT_7Ez0DLsw/    https://www.instagram.com/p/DYFTSnzoy3o/

💎 Specialty & Designer Styles (Targeting Niche Needs)

Unique silhouettes designed for specific use cases, outdoor environments, or fashion-forward aesthetics.

  • Flux (The Designer Sporty Shoe)

  • The Vibe: Next-generation aesthetics meets 3D-printed innovation.

  • Key Features: Co-designed with SCRY, this is a sporty, fully enclosed shoe featuring bold, futuristic parametric styling. It pairs a multi-layer cushion system with a wide toe box for unpinched comfort.

  • How to Sell It: Target streetwear fans, tech-wear enthusiasts, and Gen Z. Position this as a cutting-edge fashion sneaker that brings runway looks to everyday comfort.

  • Videos/Posts by our creators: https://www.instagram.com/p/DbFr-HfjJup/?img_index=1     https://www.instagram.com/p/DXeZ4_3ArVZ/?img_index=1

  • Airpuff One Pro (The 5cm Max-Cushioning Slide)

  • The Vibe: Thick, bouncy support for all-day adventures.

  • Key Features: The upgraded version of our bestselling slide, featuring an ultra-thick 5cm cloud-cushioned base. The resilient 3D-printed lattice bounces back to its original shape after repeated compression.

  • How to Sell It: Pitch this to campers, beachgoers, and those who need extreme underfoot cushioning for maximum recovery and soft landings.

  • Videos/Posts by our creators: https://www.instagram.com/p/DZ2U3OoiYbR/   https://www.instagram.com/p/DZC1AAOjUUl/    https://www.instagram.com/p/DXWPqu5jGw2/

  • Aero Pro (The Outdoor Enclosed Shoe)

  • The Vibe: A highly cushioned, roomy full shoe for outdoor relaxing.

  • Key Features: An enclosed shoe built for the outdoors, featuring upgraded multi-layer cushioning and a delightfully roomy toe box. It still retains a foldable design for easy storage.

  • How to Sell It: Target home gardeners, backyard enthusiasts, and audiences with wider feet who need a protective, fully enclosed shoe with serious cushioning.

  • Videos/Posts by our creators: https://www.instagram.com/p/Da5gn3Ny_UU/   https://www.instagram.com/p/DaK7NURlfby/    https://www.instagram.com/p/DXUXKXojHF_/

🛠️ Your Next Steps

  • Eco-Friendly Bonus: Remember to mention that all 7 styles are made with our sustainable ELASTO 1000 BIO material—a huge selling point for eco-conscious buyers!

  • Grab Your Links: Log into your affiliate dashboard today to generate your unique tracking links for each specific category or model.

  • Get the Assets: High-resolution images, lifestyle shots, and short video clips that clearly show the difference between our slides, flip-flops, and full shoes are waiting for you in our media library.
payout_period: Payments are processed monthly on the end of every month after commissions are approved and orders are confirmed.
